chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurārah, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī, concerning a man who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating: what is upon him? He said:
He gives charity to a poor person in an amount sufficient for his fill.

key_terms.بِقَدْرِ: in the measure or amount of
key_terms.شِبَعِهِ: his satiation or fill of food

ai.seo_question: What expiation is due for intercourse with one's wife during menstruation according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating. The expiation mentioned is to give charity to a poor person in an amount that satisfies his hunger.
